references.text: The previous verse describes the first five crossbars for one side of the tabernacle, and verse 27 continues with the five crossbars for the other side.
The next verse describes the middle crossbar that is to run through the planks from end to end.
A parallel text describing the actual construction of the crossbars for the tabernacle's planks, including the five bars for the other side and the back toward the west.
The description of the planks themselves (קַרְשֵׁי) that the crossbars were to hold together in the tabernacle's construction.
The description of the planks for the back of the tabernacle toward the west (יָמָּה), which is the same direction mentioned in verse 27.
